notes.title: Kunitsu-Gami anniversary update removes Denuvo from Capcom's 9/10 strategy game
notes.content:
2024 was packed with delights, from the all-conquering Balatro to the bombastic Helldivers 2, and even Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree. But Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess was my favorite surprise of the year, a true throwback to developer Capcom's older days and the era of Okami, Onimusha, and Viewtiful Joe. It's just turned one year old, and a special anniversary update includes an 8-bit gift, along with the additional note that it's removed Denuvo anti-tamper.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Free update! New extra content, Otherworldly Venture added!
notes.content:
The extra content, Otherworldly Venture, is a skill-testing mode that emphasizes exhilarating action and strategic thinking.

Set in an alternate world hidden behind the Torii Gate, this new game mode offers a streamlined version of the standard day/night cycle, featuring an endless horde of enemies. The Maiden's health does not regenerate in this mode, so it's game over when her health reaches zero.

Players are challenged to strategically plan positions and villager placements more intensively than in the main game, resulting in a demanding yet rewarding experience.

notes.title: Pre-order Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess now! On sale July 19, 2024
notes.content:
The truly unique Kagura Action Strategy game Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess will be available July 19, 2024! This visually stunning new title sees players perform dance-like sword moves and command villagers to assist in a battle against ominous otherworldly foes.
　
Pre-orders are now open, with three bonus items included:
- Mazo Talisman: Walking Basket
- Mazo Talisman: Astral Projection
- Digital Artbook

Check out the latest trailer for a glimpse of this one-of-a-kind game experience:
[previewyoutube=KGomhmnpfGk;full][/previewyoutube]
A new tale of the Kami awaits... Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess takes place on a mountain covered by defilement. During the day, purify the villages and prepare yourself for sundown. During the night, protect the Maiden against the hordes of the Seethe.

Repeat the day and night cycle until you cleanse the mountain of defilement and return peace to the land.
